title: Frontend: Landing / marketing page with hero and feature highlights
description: Create the public landing page shown to unauthenticated users. Includes a hero section, feature highlights, and CTAs to sign up.
acceptanceCriteria: Page renders at '/' for unauthenticated users
Hero section: headline, sub-headline, 'Get Started Free' and 'Sign In' buttons
Feature highlights: at least 6 features with icon, title, description

steps.details: Create src/pages/LandingPage.tsx. If user is authenticated (check authStore), redirect to /dashboard. Otherwise render the marketing page.

Hero: centered layout, large headline ('Build more. Track effortlessly. Ship with confidence.'), sub-headline, two CTA buttons using shadcn/ui Button (primary: 'Get Started Free' → /register, secondary: 'Sign In' → /login).

6-card grid using shadcn/ui Card. Features: Timeline history, GitHub changelogs, AI PM copilot, Points & levels, Project sharing, Parking lot ideas. Each card: icon (lucide-react), title, 2-line description.
Open http://localhost:5173. Verify landing page renders. Click 'Get Started Free' — navigate to /register. Resize to 375px — verify mobile layout.
